examples.translation: The ceiling in my room is white.

senses.definition: The top covering of a building or vehicle.

examples.text: هُنَاكَ عُصْفُورٌ يَقِفُ عَلَى سَقْفِ البَيْتِ.
examples.translation: There is a bird standing on the roof of the house.

notes: In Arabic, 'saqf' refers to the interior ceiling of a room, but can also refer to the 'roof' of a building. Context usually clarifies whether one is talking about the plaster above their head or the exterior structure.
Do not confuse this with 'sath' (سطح), which specifically refers to the flat roof or rooftop terrace where one might walk or hang laundry.
